description: Watches: configure, unfurl and save free. Save a Watch to your key so you can recall it from any door and be told what changed since your last delivery. Saving is free, up to 5 saved Watches per verified email or key (see list_standard_watches terms); past that the answer is cap-reached with the next step (retire one, or ask us), and nothing is saved or charged. Pass watchId to edit a Watch you saved: that is a new version and takes no new place. Either start from a standard Watch (base; these read the Strait of Hormuz record) or name your own domain (domain + topics, from get_quote). For a domain, the coverage check runs again here and only covered topics are kept; no reading builder is published for this domain yet, so its reading is cannot-measure per topic and it is never served a standard Watch's reading. A standard Watch with no reading yet (its `reading` is not-yet-projected) is saved as pending coverage and takes none of your free places; it becomes a delivered Watch only if you choose. A domain Watch is saved as pending coverage until a reading for it is published; a domain with no covered topic is refused with the reason. Needs your key. Same content as POST /api/v1/watches.

base.description: The standard Watch to start from: std.hormuz.maritime-operator, std.hormuz.energy-desk, std.us-iran.geopolitical-analyst. Leave it out when you name a domain.

coordinates.description: The coordinates you want to change from the base Watch; every one you leave out takes the base Watch's value. Keys: observer, question, domain, interval, language, depth, cadence, selection, thresholds, permission, delivery. Today the reading honours depth and delivery; the rest are recorded on your Watch and stated as not yet applied.

domain.description: Your domain in your own words, e.g. Arizona startup ecosystem. Use with topics instead of base.

label.description: Your own name for the Watch.

quoteId.description: The quoteId get_quote returned. Recorded with the Watch; the coverage is checked again here either way.

topics.description: The topics your domain splits into (get_quote proposes them), as names or {name, scope}; 1 to 40. Only the ones coverage we keep reads are kept; the rest come back as free coverage requests.

watchId.description: Edit this saved Watch (a new version) instead of saving a new one.

name: save_watch
